activity_statements.statement: resells and integrates enterprise IT hardware and software (Cisco, NVIDIA, NetApp, Palo Alto, Microsoft, AWS) for large enterprise and government customers
operates an Advanced Technology Center (ATC) running 30,000+ VMs and 1,000+ simultaneous on-demand labs enabling enterprise customers to proof-of-concept and validate IT solutions before deployment
delivers AI-at-scale implementation services as a primary launch partner for the Red Hat AI Factory with NVIDIA, enabling enterprise AI industrialization
provides cybersecurity consulting and security posture assessment services for enterprises and government clients under its ARMOR framework
holds major U.S. Army contracts (GEMSS EA) to supply Cisco network security products and support services to the military

name_reality_gap: Indexed as 'Information Technology' — this captures it at a high level, but 'World Wide Technology' sounds like a global hardware conglomerate. In reality WWT is primarily a privately-held IT solutions integrator and reseller, not a manufacturer. The ATC lab infrastructure and AI implementation capabilities are not what the name suggests.
extraction_notes: WWT.com is JS-gated with a browser check that blocks standard crawlers. The solutions page loaded but contained primarily news/blog content rather than a structured product/service overview. ATC details, GEMSS contract, and partner list extracted from page content that did render. Site blocked multiple URL attempts. Confidence moderate — core business (IT resale + integration) is well-known public fact for WWT.
